errors.text_span: A red dashed line is annotated with "mean: 0.82"
errors.evidence: The description inaccurately states that the red dashed line is annotated with the text. In the chart, the line and the text "mean: 0.82" are two separate visual elements. The text is positioned to explain the line, but it is not physically attached to it as an annotation. The reference more accurately states the line is "accompanied by" the text.
